problem.problem_title: Real-time Monitoring and Feedback for CSF Shunt Implantation
problem.problem_description: Current CSF shunt implantation procedures lack real-time monitoring and feedback, making it challenging to ensure proper shunt placement and function. This can lead to complications, revisions, and increased healthcare costs. The eShunt System creates a CSF shunt between the subarachnoid space and the dural venous sinus, but there is no integrated monitoring to confirm: (1) proper shunt deployment, (2) CSF flow through the shunt, (3) pressure gradient adequacy, (4) absence of occlusion, (5) long-term patency.
problem.rationale: CereVasc eShunt addresses CSF diversion but has no monitoring solution. Current shunt revision rates are 30-50% within 2 years. Real-time monitoring during implantation and post-implantation would: (1) reduce revision surgeries, (2) enable early intervention, (3) provide clinical data for PMA submission, (4) differentiate from VP shunt competitors. This is a GREEN white space — no competitor has endovascular CSF shunt monitoring. CereVasc could build a platform patent around it.
